decision_rationale: The record is a retrieval-and-distillation framework that uses unpaired pathology reports to supervise a vision model, not a primary text-bio foundation model. The biological modality is histology images, and the text reports are used as privileged external supervision.
evidence_snippet: “uses a CLIP model ... to retrieve the most relevant unpaired textual report for each image” and “Knowledge from these texts is distilled into the vision model during training”
